token.title: Alynki API token (optional — leave blank to sign in instead)
token.description: Issued to you by your Alynki operator. Leave this blank to sign in with your own identity instead — Claude Code will offer OAuth on first use. A configured token is stored in this plugin's settings.json, not the OS keychain, since the value must be readable by this plugin's headersHelper script.
